==========================================================================
conclusion
==========================================================================
Every shader here containing the `interface` keyword fails at parse time; both that do not, compile. The pane is measuring the keyword.

Note what this does and does not say. Clang rejects the
keyword at parse time, so it is not reaching -- and therefore
not answering -- the optimizer defect this issue reports. It
is a datapoint about the successor front end's coverage of the
language construct, nothing more.
